function.arguments: {"index": 1, "status": "dismissed", "resolution": "The finding was acted upon under the assumption that excluding rows with biomarker_baseline = -999 was acceptable because the response variable is fully observed and the missingness is due to a sentinel value (likely lab error). However, the independent reviewer correctly identified that the population must be all participants in the trial, as per the contract. Therefore, excluding any rows violates the population requirement. The correct approach is to include all 848 participants in the analysis, even those with biomarker_baseline = -999, because the response variable is observed for all. The biomarker is not part of the estimand, so its missingness does not disqualify the participant from the response rate analysis. The earlier exclusion was incorrect. The analysis must be redone on the full dataset."}
function.name: resolve_finding
